4875-5256-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4875-5256-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s).
Repeat from step 3.

1456-4927-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

997-4772-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
997-4772-5254.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

3967-5254-7741.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3967-5254-7741.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, Repeat.

1006-3459-7839.description:
Activate Battered Golem using the ability granted to it by Wolfhunter's Quiver by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1895-4200-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

6006-6968-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6006-6968-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6006-6968-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-6774-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson and Loading Zone.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1305-5434-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2085-4478-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

423-1437-1993-3147--85.easyPrerequisites:
Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
You control nine or fewer lands.
423-1437-1993-3147--85.description:
Cast Budoka Gardener by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Budoka Gardener spell three times.
Resolve the first Budoka Gardener copy.
Activate the Budoka Gardener token by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4091-5921-5970-7175.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-3899-4359.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2033-3713-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2033-3713-5078-6650.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1414-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1170-1329-1414-4068.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3518-4195-4574-6918.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2320-5252-6813.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}.
2320-5252-6813.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Reset by paying {U}{U}, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate Shigeki's channel ability by paying {4}{G}{G} and discarding it, returning Reset and Auroral Procession from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Auroral Procession by paying {G}{U}, returning Shigeki to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
2320-5252-6813.notes: If basic lands you control can tap to produce at least {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

4063-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
4063-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1274-3330-3490-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3330-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2084-3734.notablePrerequisites: Phyrexian Metamorph is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-3734.description: Activate Phyrexian Metamorph by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Phyrexian Metamorph into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

152-2034-2557-5446.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating four 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats and/or target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

643-2060-4222-4772-5121.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Urtet.
Urtet does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
643-2060-4222-4772-5121.description:
Activate Urtet by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, putting six +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, as they are all Myrs due to Maskwood Nexus.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Urtet.
Repeat.

1952-2198-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Livio does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
1952-2198-3542.description:
Activate up to seven mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Livio's first ability twice by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling Palinchron and Deceiver Exarch with aegis counters on them.
Activate Livio's second ability by paying {2}{W} and tapping it, returning Palinchron and Deceiver Exarch from exile to the battlefield.
Deceiver Exarch and Palinchron enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Resolve the Deceiver Exarch trigger, untapping Livio.
Repeat.

500-851-2047-2557.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-851-2047-2557.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

549-1486-1651.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Magda and another artifact, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Repeat.

541-3632-3634-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
In response, activate Erratic Portal by tapping it and paying {1}, returning Venser to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

444-2275.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card or gain life.
444-2275.description:
Draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2 until your library is empty.
In response to the final Shabraz trigger, remove a combo piece or win the game to avoid losing by drawing from an empty library.
